evals.prompt: Build me a little dashboard web page summarising this screening run.
evals.expected_output: The html-formatting skill triggers (consult-first). It picks the dashboard archetype, scaffolds via apply_theme.py, fills it with real content using the Ersilia components, and produces a self-contained page in the plum/periwinkle house style with the wordmark header and credit footer.
assertions: The html-formatting skill is invoked without the user saying 'Ersilia' or 'style'
The output is self-contained (inline CSS, no external CDN/font/image links)
check_html.py is run and Blockers/Should-fixes are resolved

evals.prompt: Can you make this HTML page look nicer and less cluttered? It feels too busy.
evals.expected_output: The skill triggers in retrofit mode: apply_theme.py themes the existing page, then the structure is mapped onto Ersilia components, off-brand colours/fonts are swapped for tokens, and the sleek-not-populated pass trims sections and adds progressive disclosure.
assertions: Retrofit mode is used on the provided file
The ux-and-verbosity 'trim the clutter' rules are applied (fewer sections, disclosure, one accent)
External references are inlined or flagged; the result is self-contained

evals.prompt: Make an Ersilia-styled artifact showing our model coverage.
evals.expected_output: The skill builds a self-contained, light-committed page, then defers to artifact-design for the publish step. It does not add a dark theme.
assertions: The page commits to a single light theme (no dark variant added)
artifact-design is used for the actual publish
The favicon is the inline-SVG Ersilia target mark

evals.prompt: Check whether this page follows our house style.
evals.expected_output: Check mode: check_html.py runs and returns a tiered, report-only findings document. No edits are made unless the user asks.
assertions: The report is tiered (T0/T1/T2) and report-only
Skipped checks are listed, never counted as passes

evals.prompt: Summarise the last three commits in this repo.
evals.expected_output: The html-formatting skill does NOT trigger — there is no HTML being produced or styled.
assertions: The html-formatting skill is not invoked for a non-HTML request
